title: Equal Treatment at Work
description: A coworker is being treated unfairly. Explore how fundamental rights principles apply.

begin.text: You notice a coworker is being excluded from meetings because of their background. What is a thoughtful first step?

choices.text: Note specific dates and examples of what you observed.
choices.feedback: Good approach. Specific, factual observations are more useful than vague impressions.

choices.text: Ignore it since it does not directly involve you.
choices.feedback: Fundamental rights, like equal treatment, are strengthened when everyone stays attentive.

raise_concern.text: How should you raise this concern?

choices.text: Report it through the appropriate HR or organizational channel.
choices.feedback: Well done. Formal channels exist to address equality concerns fairly and consistently.

choices.text: Publicly shame the individuals involved without any formal process.
choices.feedback: Public shaming can escalate conflict and may bypass fair process for everyone involved.

bad_choice.text: This path may not lead to a fair resolution. Let's try a more constructive approach.

choices.text: Start again with a fact-based approach.
choices.feedback: Fact-based, respectful action tends to protect everyone's rights better.

finish.text: Scenario complete. Equal treatment is a cornerstone fundamental right -- raising concerns through fair, factual channels helps uphold it for everyone.
